title: PYXEL_interactions
description: The PYXEL_interactions extra of a glTF 2 node: the list of active objects of a model. Objects of version 1.0 are checked in full; objects of other versions only for `name` and `version`, as the importer decides what to do with them. Rules that need the whole model, such as which names are groups and which are lights, are not checked here. See docs/model-interactions.md.

name.description: Name of an active object, a light or a slot: no dot and no slash.

version.description: Major and minor version of the specification, as in SemVer with the patch version 0, with no leading zeros.

stateName.description: Name of a state declared in `states`.

activeObject_1_0.description: An active object of version 1.0. If `name` is the name of a light of the model, the object describes that light and may only have `transitions`, with the single target `light`; otherwise it is geometry-based.

states.description: State names to state declarations. The order of the keys matters: the first state is the starting state.

name.description: Unique within the object; `visible` is reserved.

type.description: `int` and `color` are reserved for future versions.

default.description: A value of the slot's type; when missing, the default-initialized value of the type.

offset.description: Lengths in meters along X, Y and Z.

slotValue.description: bool for boolean; a number for float, factor, angle (radians) and length (meters); three lengths for offset.

state.description: Group names and slot references (`$` and the declared name of an output slot or a variable) to their lists of transformations.

additionalProperties.description: Transformations of a group, composed in this order; each channel at most once.

vector.description: Values for X, Y and Z; a missing one takes the default value of the channel.

groupTransformation.description: A single-key mapping setting one channel. Angles in radians, lengths in meters.

label.description: Text shown in the UI; need not be unique.

when.description: The state the action leaves, or a list of them.

then.description: The state the action leads to.

transitions.description: Targets to transition values. A target is `*` (the defaults), a group name, `$` and the name of an output slot or a variable, or `light` in an object describing a light.

transition.description: `none`, or a comma-separated list of single-channel transitions: a channel, a timing function and up to two times (duration, then delay), in any order. The pattern accepts lowercase keywords and units only, as the exporter writes them; the specification also accepts any case.
